## SK Hynix Seeks to Sell China Chip Facility Amid Export Control Pressure

A China facility exit by SK Hynix would de-risk its geopolitical exposure but also remove production capacity at a time when HBM supply is tight. The move reinforces the structural trend of memory supply chain bifurcation along geopolitical lines — relevant to the entire HBM competitive landscape thesis.

- SK Hynix is reportedly seeking to divest its chip facility located in southwest China.
- Coverage frames the move as driven by geopolitical dynamics and US export controls — not operational underperformance.
- The exit would reduce SK Hynix's China production footprint with implications for memory supply chain geography.
